title: Decoding the Multimodal Maze: A Systematic Review on the Adoption of Explainability in Multimodal Attention-based Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing explainability toolkits (such as Inseq) that evaluate gender bias in Neural Machine Translation (NMT) by analyzing the use of occupations and pronouns to uncover spurious correlations across gendered translations using perturbation, gradient, and attribution methods.
